title: HERMES Complete Architecture Latency Audit Summary

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Tier 1 Model Generation Duration
top_10_bottlenecks.description: DeepSeek-R1 8B token generation duration (~30.2 tok/s over 300-800 tokens). Primary critical-path consumer.
top_10_bottlenecks.optimization: Prompt compression, system prompt token reduction, structured JSON output constraints.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Tier 1 <-> Tier 2 VRAM Model Switching
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Eviction of DeepSeek-R1 and reloading of Qwen3 8B into 6GB VRAM on every verification cycle.
top_10_bottlenecks.optimization: Progressive verification gates: skip full T2 verification for low-risk read-only tools.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Tier 2 Verification Model Inference
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Qwen3 8B generating full cross-model verification reasoning on every stage.
top_10_bottlenecks.optimization: Heuristic & AST sanity checks before invoking T2; targeted verification.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Stage 11 Memory Extraction LLM Call
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Synchronous LLM call in Stage 11 to extract memory facts after tool execution, causing another VRAM reload/inference cycle.
top_10_bottlenecks.optimization: Decouple memory extraction to background task; regex-based fact extraction fallback.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Workspace Full Directory Traversal & Hashing
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Repeated recursive scanning of workspace folders and AST parsing on every request.
top_10_bottlenecks.optimization: In-memory workspace index cache with mtime invalidation.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Tool Subprocess Spawning Overhead
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Windows process creation latency when spawning python/git/pytest subprocesses.
top_10_bottlenecks.optimization: Direct Python execution in-process where safe; persistent subprocess workers.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Context Builder Prompt Formatting & Token Redundancy
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Duplication of tool schemas, system instructions, and file trees across turns.
top_10_bottlenecks.optimization: Differential context builder with cached static prompt prefix.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Task Planning SQLite Queue Serialization
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Synchronous database writes to data/kairos.db during Stage 2 task registration.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Skill Metadata Re-parsing
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Reading and regex-parsing 12 SKILL.md files on IntentClassifier initialization.

top_10_bottlenecks.name: Structured Observation & File Delta Tracking
top_10_bottlenecks.description: Diffing rglob('*') files before and after tool execution.
top_10_bottlenecks.optimization: Targeted file delta tracking based on modified path metadata.
